text.en:
The Commission on Higher Education shall instruct all state
universities and colleges (SUCs) to devise a flexible, socially-sensitive tuition fee
payment plan and reform the no-payment, no periodic examination policy that is
currently being applied;

The administrators of the Students' Assistance Fund for
Education shall expand the coverage of the program. On top of tuition,
beneficiaries of the program should receive the following additional benefits:
1. Monthly stipend to subsidize the students' transport fares, and
2. Laboratory, research and book allowance.

This Order shall take effect immediately.
Done in the City of Manila on the 21st of April in the year of Our Lord, Two
Thousand and Nine.
Uterine Mr. herago
By the President:
EDUARDO R. ERMITA
Executive Secretary
